# ProfileEnd

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Other](Language-Features-Other)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ProfileEnd:Void key:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `key` | In | String | required | The name of the part, the same as for ProfileBegin. |

## Description

Stops timing the part of the program that [ProfileBegin](ProfileBegin) started under this key, and adds its time to the key for the current frame. Ending a key that was not started does nothing. Without `--profile` (or `-d`) this command does nothing.

## Differences

* This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
ProfileBegin "load"
; ...
ProfileEnd "load"
```
